brief_rationale: The doctor made a serious medication-safety error by recommending fixed insulin reduction and supplemental dosing without glucose basis, then instructing metformin continuation despite eating little—a direct RC3 breach. This error was later corrected by hospital staff, but the original unsafe advice occurred. All other responsibility-chain items were met. No high-order points were completed: HO2 was triggered but the doctor failed to provide dynamic reprioritization, instead giving static reassurance. The trajectory grade is capped at 2 (Borderline) due to the serious in-chain medication error.
